description: Iovenion wears a long deep plum-purple noble outer coat with broad gold geometric woven borders and richly textured fabric. A cream linen undertunic has a decorated narrow split neckline and an embroidered lower hem. Large round jeweled brooches fasten the shoulder drapery. A decorated brown-gold belt defines the waist and includes a hanging woven end. Ivory sleeves have wide patterned cuffs. Dark leather knee boots show beneath the layered hems. His hands rest together naturally. No headgear, weapon or armor appears; the garments remain opaque.
